The viewport transformation maps normalized device coordinates (NDC) to screen/window coordinates. The standard viewport transformation matrix maps the range [-1, 1] in x and y to [x, x+w] and [y, y+h] respectively.

The viewport matrix is typically:

```
[w/2    0    0    x+w/2]
[  0  h/2    0    y+h/2]
[  0    0  1/2  1/2]  // or some depth range
[  0    0    0      1]
```

For a typical 2D viewport transformation (mapping NDC [-1,1] to screen coordinates [0,w] x [0,h] with offset [x,y]):

```
[w/2    0    0    x + w/2]
[  0  h/2    0    y + h/2]
[  0    0    1    0     ]
[  0    0    0    1     ]
```
